subject.title: fix(linux): always surface manual update results

question: Should this PR require a redacted live Linux desktop proof of the notification result before merge, or is the existing policy-table coverage sufficient because the notification mechanism is unchanged?
rationale: The proposed change alters when a native notification is selected, and the contributor explicitly reports that notification rendering was not exercised after the fix.

options.title: Require live Linux proof
options.body: Capture a redacted desktop recording, terminal output, or runtime logs showing a manual remote-webview update check reaches the user before merge.

options.title: Accept policy-only proof
options.body: Merge based on the decision-table tests if the responsible Linux desktop owner confirms the unchanged notification mechanism makes live proof unnecessary.

recommendation.title: Require live Linux proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted desktop recording, terminal output, or runtime logs showing a manual remote-webview update check reaches the user before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the only evidence-backed current contributor for the Linux updater change in the supplied review context.
